title: Infrastructure Migration Review
summary: Frank Thompson and Grace Liu discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for next Friday, but Frank Thompson's revised estimate is end of the month. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'next Friday' early in meeting, then revised to 'end of the month'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'next Friday' and 'end of the month'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
